_doc: CANONICAL EXAMPLE of a faction sheet (2 of NAPC's 19 units). Copy to game/data/balance/units_<code>.json, change 'faction', and author ALL bible units of that faction (V-CMP-01).

Numbers come from: python3 tools/py/balance_calc.py proposals --faction <code> --styled (cost, build_s, hp, speed, vision, radius). Tier, prerequisites, producer are bible-owned: omit them (a repeated tier is only V-CNF-02 info; a different one is V-CNF-01). Exception: set 'tier' only for a real override that the bible states.

Weapon instance = archetype from global.json weapon_archetypes + damage/hits_per_volley/reload_s/range_cells; archetype-locked fields (damage_type, fire_mode, projectile_kind) are forbidden (V-CNF-08). Slot number = position in the unit's 'weapons' list.

Abilities are bare framework names (aliases) or ability.<kind>.<variant> template ids; params override via ability_params. Implicit abilities (detector for bible tag 'detector', transport for veh_scout ...) are added by the loader: do not list them.
Keys: units/weapons/summons sorted by id (V-SCH-09); numbers <= 3 decimals; integer fields integral. Validate: python3 tools/py/validate_balance.py --strict --only units_<code>.json
Keys starting with an underscore (like this one) are documentation and ignored.
